Theme

School & learning

survey noun

a general view of a subject

also overview, general survey, synopsis, at a glance

classical

Cic. Brut. 15: ūnō in cōnspectū omnia vidērem
Cic. de Orat. 3.161: in cōnspectū animī (Lewis & Short)
Gell. 17.21.2 (Lewis & Short)

cōnspectus, cōnspectūs m.

noun, fourth declension

a view, survey; (in Gellius) a synopsis

Properly sight, the range of the eyes (in cōnspectū, in view). The mental survey is rare but good prose; a written synopsis is Gellius’s use (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • ut explicātīs ōrdinibus temporum ūnō in cōnspectū omnia vidērem

    so that, with the order of the dates laid out, I could see everything in a single surveyCic. Brut. 15

See also chart, survey.

SourcesLewis & Short: conspectus
